TUO YRREJ PEEK

by Mike Sylvia

ANSWER: SILENCE OF THE LAMBS / REMAINS OF THE DAY


For a listing of all submitted videos, see Film Screening.

When teams submitted their Sweded movie, they received the instruction: "Your answer is the title of the most recent film to sweep the Big Five Oscars, minus the leading article". This leads to the answer SILENCE OF THE LAMBS.

The supplementary information from 1926 reveals that in the alternate history, Oscar winners were selected deterministically, based on a set of rules. A complete listing of Oscar winners based on these rules can be found here. This changes the answer to REMAINS OF THE DAY.
